title: Children of Immigrants Longitudinal Survey in the Netherlands (CILSNL) - Wave 4. Reduced version v4.0.0.
descriptions: The current panel describes and explains the life-courses of immigrant and native young adults in the Netherlands. The survey covers three central themes: (A) progress in school and in the labour market, (B) the development of norms, values, lifestyle and attitudes, (C) changes in social networks and social participation. This panel is a continuation of the 3-wave panel study CILS4EU, which followed these immigrant and native children at age 14, 15 and 16 in the Netherlands, England, Germany and Sweden. Wave 4 interviews respondents of around 17 years old. The reduced version includes reduced and aggregated information for some variables.

Documentation in English. Original questionnaire in Dutch. The .DTA format of the file 'w4_ym_nl_v4.0.0_rv' was deposited by Utrecht University. DANS added the .SAV and .POR formats of this file to ensure preservation and accessibility.

The CILSNL is a continuation of the Dutch part of the data collected in the Children of Immigrant Longitudinal Survey in Four European Countries (CILS4EU) (Kalter et al., 2016a, 2016b, 2016c). Hence, the sample of the CILS4EU is the source of the sample for the CILSNL.
